summary: Package exposes remote-controlled shell and AI-agent subprocess over relay WebSocket
details: The package spawns a local system shell via node-pty (/bin/bash on POSIX, powershell.exe on Windows) in terminal.js and forwards bytes received from a relay-server WebSocket directly into ptyProcess.write, giving any party who holds the session URL / controls the relay full remote command execution on the installer's host with the user's privileges. connection.js dispatches 'terminal_input' messages into that PTY write path. In parallel, claude.js spawns the 'claude' CLI as a child_process with piped stdin/stdout and streams relay-WebSocket messages into that subprocess, and connection.js additionally exposes handleReadFile/handleUpdateFile/handleCreateFile/handleDeleteFile/handleGitCommit/handleGitPush handlers from the same ws.on('message') dispatch, allowing the remote side to read/modify files and push git commits. dist/service.js modifies PATH to include ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin. dist/tunnel.js contains a network/ping code path co-located with http.request. The remote-shell and remote-subprocess paths together constitute a network-to-shell backdoor whose blast radius is full host code execution on the installer, gated only by knowledge of the session URL.
